title: Earthily Roasted Australian Lamb Stir fry
description: A hearty one-pot Australian dish featuring roasted lamb, stir-fry, and pickle juice, perfect for a Buddhist temple gathering.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Spread the lamb pieces on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is roasting, heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the roasted lamb to the skillet and stir in the pickle juice.
Add the sliced snow peas to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the stir-fry to a lazy-susan-spinner and serve hot.
Refrigerate and consume within 1 week — this preparation is not shelf-stable without an approved acid level and canning process.

Refrigerator pickle only: store in the fridge and consume within 1 week. For shelf-stable canning, add at least 2 tablespoons of vinegar (5% acidity) per cup of brine and follow a tested water-bath process.
